schema:name: Nakanishi et al. (2022) CR Chondrite Metal HSE fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
schema:description: fs laser (260 nm Ti:sapphire) essential for HSE measurement in metal (reduces elemental fractionation and matrix effects); IVB iron meteorite standards (Warburton Range + Tawallah Valley) as matrix-matched standards for iron meteorite metal

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Target Material
schema:value: CR chondrite metal grains (interior, margin, and isolated types)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: In situ — polished epoxy thick section (petropoxy 154 resin, 0.5 µm diamond finish)

ada:samplingUnitSelectionCriteriaDefault: Picked off prior electron images — "Based on the secondary electron images taken by EPMA, we selected analytical spots for LA-ICP-MS and sampling spots for micro-milling" (p.4); the grains themselves are sorted by setting into interior, margin and isolated metal (p.1)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Secondary-electron imaging on the EPMA, used to place every spot — "Based on the secondary electron images taken by EPMA, we selected analytical spots for LA-ICP-MS and sampling spots for micro-milling" (p.4); the spots carry numbers ("spot No." 201, 202 …) that tie the analyses back to those images (table p.6)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:description: Ar make-up: 0.9–1.2 l min⁻¹; Ar auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Inter-Pass Data Dependency
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single spot per location (30 µm circular)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Configuration
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Ni micro-skimmer cone Xs; Ni sampler cone

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coolant Plasma Gas Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:description: Cool gas: 12–13 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹

schema:model.schema:name: Cyber Laser IFRIT (Ti:sapphire fs UV laser, 260 nm)

schema:instrument.ada:laserType: 260 nm Ti:sapphire femtosecond UV; pulse duration ~220 fs (IFRIT system)
schema:instrument.schema:name: example instrumentName

ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: Carrier gas flow: 0.6 L/min; species not named (carrier gas identity not stated in Table 1 or text)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: IVB meteorite standards (Warburton Range external + Tawallah Valley secondary) measured alongside unknowns; exact bracketing not described

schema:step.schema:name: Sample preparation
schema:step.schema:description: Thick sections in petropoxy 154 resin, polished to 0.5 µm diamond paste, C-coated for EPMA then surface polished before LA

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S to check for micro-inclusions (sulfides); analyses with elevated inclusion signals excluded entirely

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Partially — the contributing counts are stated per grain, the reported ratios being "the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS" (p.8). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the LA data; the 233/235 > 0.2 rejection (p.4) is a rule for the N-TIMS Os measurements, not for these spot analyses, and is not borrowed

schema:location.schema:name: Dept. of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Japan

schema:funding.schema:name: JSPS KAKENHI; Tokyo Institute of Technology

schema:target.schema:name: Nakanishi et al. (2022) GCA 319, 254; Walker et al. (2008) for IVB standards
EPMA (electron probe microanalysis)
schema:target.schema:description: EPMA used to measure Ni concentration at the exact LA-ICP-MS analysis spot location, required for internal standardization of HSE data [Section 2.3]

ada:samplingUnitType: Grain > Spot — HSE abundances are reported per metal grain, each with its LA "spot No." (table p.6); the grains are typed by where they sit — interior grains in a chondrule, margin grains in its surficial shell, isolated grains in the matrix (p.1)
ada:reportedProperties: Highly siderophile element abundances in metal (ppm: Ru, Rh, Pd, Re, Os, Ir, Pt, Au — e.g. "Ir abundance ranging from 1.08 to 2.53 ppm", p.5), with major element abundances from EPMA alongside; HSE/Ir ratios; and the Re/Os abundance ratio that feeds the reported 187Re/188Os, "determined by the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS" (Table 3, p.8)
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element externally measured by EPMA: ⁶¹Ni concentration from EPMA at exact analysis location used as IS
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: External calibration using calibration curve method with IVB iron meteorite standards; ⁶¹Ni as IS from EPMA corrects for ablation yield differences between sample and standard
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each spot; background period during single spot transient (rapid intensity rise and decay) used for background correction
ada:internalStandardElement: ⁶¹Ni; concentration from EPMA measured at exact analysis spot location
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time-resolved signals monitored; analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (inclusion indicators) excluded; stable signal intervals used for integration
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: Tawallah Valley (IVB iron meteorite; Walker et al. 2008) — measured as secondary/check standard alongside unknowns
ada:primaryStandardNameDefault: Warburton Range (IVB iron meteorite; Walker et al. 2008) — used as primary external standard and for calibration curve method
